lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: My Lord.
Let me guess, alcohol?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Most correct.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: In fact, I intended to bring some spirits over

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: when my eyes chanced upon a book on the ground.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: And heavens above, 'twere about alcohol!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Within that book's pages there was contained

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: script pertaining to what was called an "Alcohol Bomb."
Alcohol bomb?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: The script declares that

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: through the intermarriage of various intoxicants,

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: one can produce a most fanciful potation.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: What say thou?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Shall we caution an attempt upon it?
Let's mix alcohol from the surface and from the Ark.
Will it even taste any good?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: My Lord,

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: never allow such jaundiced words to spill from thy tongue before imbibing it thyself!
All right, let's give it a try.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Jolly good, that's the spirit!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: We shall invent a new elixir.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Oh, how mine spirit quivers with excitement

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I shall procure a most alluring spirit and join to thy lodgings soon.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: As for thou, my Lord,

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: thou must do the same here in the Ark.
Okay
